title: Chapter 124 Super God Realm Powerful
content:
Chapter 124 Super God Realm Powerful

So, the current scene appeared.

At this time, the third elder of the Tianlin Palace had already arrived beside Wang Zhen and said with a flattering look on his face: "General Wang, the villain has killed Tang Sheng."

"How is this possible!!"

Hearing this, Luo Ming and others in the distance were shocked.

Tang Sheng, was killed? !

No wonder Tang Sheng hasn't come back now.

It turned out that he had already fallen.

That is the most promising powerhouse in the God of War Star Realm now.

If this matter is known by the God of War Star Domain, I would have been more desperate.

In the starry sky, Wang Zhen had no expression on this, but said lightly: "I understand, your mission is completed, you can leave."

Then Wang Zhen threw it to him.

Looking at the ring in his hand, the third elder of Lindian smiled that day.

"General Wang, what do you mean?"

His original intention was to join the terrifying force of the Divine Dynasty.

Unfortunately, Wang Zhen did not have this idea, so his plan could only be ruined.

Wang Zhen ignored him at all, but went straight towards Luo Ming, Yan Yan and others in the distance.

In place, the third elder of Yuantianlin Palace glanced at Wang Zhen, who didn't take him seriously at all, and looked at the ring in his hand. Even if he was unwilling to give up, he had to give up.

At least, he saved his life and obtained a considerable amount of wealth.

At worst, find a place to live forever.

Then he glanced at the presence last and then left here as if he ran away.

On the other hand, Luo Ming and others in the Tianlin Star Domain looked extremely ugly at this moment. At this time, the Tianlin Star Domain was already in a desperate situation.

As the top-level combat power, they can still struggle to support the generals of the Divine Dynasty, but the combat power below was almost crushed by the Divine Dynasty army.

In a short time, the barrier of the star domain in Tianlin will be shattered by the Divine Dynasty.

By then, the entire Tianlin Star Domain will be taken down by the Divine Dynasty.

Looking at Wang Zhen who was slowly walking towards this side, everyone felt a deep sense of despair.

Are you really going to lose?

"Lo Palace Master, do you still have a trump card in Tianlin Star Domain?"

Next to Luo Ming, Yan Yan said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, Luo Ming looked ugly, but then his expression lit up again.

The next moment, Luo Ming took a step forward and shouted, "Do you really want to kill the death?"

"Tell you, there are super god-level powerful people in my Tianlin Star Domain!"

As soon as these words were spoken, the audience was shocked.

Super God-level powerhouse!

The powerful man in the God Emperor realm is already the strongest man in the powerful star field.

The super-divine realm power has the power of the super-divine realm power on the surface. They have never even heard of it except the Divine Dynasty.

Is there any in the Tianlin Star Domain?

Yan Yan frowned and said, "Lo Palace Master, you are making such a joke. How is this possible for a super god-level powerful person?"

However, Luo Ming sneered confidently: "That's just you don't know."

Hearing this, Yan Yan continued to ask, "Lo Palace Master, I wonder who the super god realm power is?"

Luo Ming stood with his hands behind his back and said calmly, "It's not someone else, it's the former head of the Tianlin Palace, Han Tianren."

Han Tianren?

Hearing this name, Wang Zhen frowned in the distance.

He still knew this person. It was the former palace master of Tianlin Palace. This time he came, he had never seen that old guy.

Could it be that guy really made a breakthrough?

But at this time, Yan Yan became excited.

"Hahaha, super god realm powerhouse, then this time, the Divine Dynasty will inevitably fail."

Immediately, Yan Yan looked at the army of the Divine Dynasty proudly.

"Your Divine Dynasty is indeed very strong, but you have the power of a super-divine powerhouse. I think even you have to consider it, right?"

Looking at Yan Yan's expression, he obviously believed Luo Ming's words completely.

For a moment, the strong men in the Divine Dynasty were a little confused.

Although Luo Ming looks like he is talking big, he can't even cheat his teammates.

Thinking of this, they believed Luo Ming's words.

But what they didn't know was that these were just acts by Luo Ming and Yan Yan.

At this time, a general of a high level came to Wang Zhen and whispered: "General, what should I do now?"

Upon hearing this, Wang Zhen sneered, "What, do you believe it?"

Seeing this, the general quickly fell down.

Wang Zhen snorted coldly and then stepped forward.

"A super god realm powerhouse? Haha, I really want to see the strength of your super god realm powerhouse in the Tianlin Star Realm."

He did not believe at all about the powerful person in the super-divine realm of the Tianlin Star Domain.

Because as a powerful man from the super god realm, he knew very well how difficult it was to enter the super god realm.

Even though he was in the resource-rich Supreme God Star Domain, it took him tens of millions of years to do so, but he still failed to do it.

Not to mention that they are not as good as the Tianlin Star Domain in their divine star domain.

He didn't believe it at all when he saw Wang Zhen.

Although Luo Ming still had a confident smile on his face, he was already panicking inside.

What's more, I'm still injured and haven't recovered. If I really want to fight, it's over.

What to do?

Now there is really no trick.

At this time, Wang Zhen had rushed towards Luo Ming and others again.

Suddenly, the void shattered and the terrifying divine power continued to pour out.

Judging from this, Wang Zhen is going to be serious.

It's over!

Luo Ming was extremely sad.

Could it be that Tianlin Palace was really going to fall into his hands?

At this moment of despair, a roar suddenly came from the depths of the starry sky, mixed with a familiar and terrifying breath.

"Stop!"

Boom!

A terrifying divine power suddenly attacked Wang Zhen.

A roar sounded.

The next moment, Wang Zhen took a few steps back, staring at the depths of the starry sky with a look of fear.

I saw an old man in a long robe rushing towards here.

"Old Palace Master!"

The person who came was the former Palace Master of Tianlin Palace, Han Tianren!

Seeing Han Tianren, Luo Ming smiled bitterly.

"Old Palace Master, if you don't come, I really can't hold on."

Looking at Luo Ming's pale face at this moment, Han Tianren was also a little apologetic.

"Luo Ming, thank you for your hard work. Next, you just watch."

Hearing this, Luo Ming and Yan Yan and others were shocked.

Such confident words.

Could it be? !

"Old Palace Master, you have broken through?!"

Have you really reached the super god realm?

Hearing this, Han Tianren stood with his hands behind his back, looking like a master.

"Of course,,,, no more."

......

No,,

Isn't it still a mess?

Yan Yan and the other strong men in the Hun Gu Star Domain looked ugly. After a long time, they still couldn't beat them.

At this time, the old man in the Hun Gu Star Domain stepped forward and said in a deep voice: "Palace Master Han, if you have a way, please tell me quickly. If not, we will retreat."

With this time, they might as well go back and prepare. Although it will not be very useful, it is better than wasting time here.

Hearing this, Han Tianren smiled faintly and said: "What do you think I went there for?"
